review_candidates.description: Job Description: Position Summary - Primary Purpose Of The Role Owns the reliability, release and operational control of the BIDS trading platform across production environments in the United States, Canada and Europe. Accountable for production deployment, incident response, disaster recovery, and the regulatory control framework that governs the operation of an alternative trading system. Leads a team spanning site reliability engineering and database administration and directs the continued evolution of hybrid of on-premises and AWS environments. The role is deliberately hands-on: the incumbent both leads the function and personally executes or supervises production change. Role Overview BIDS Trading operates an alternative trading system for institutional block equity trading, with production environments across the United States, Canada and Europe. We are looking for a Director of Production Operations to own the reliability, release and operational control of that platform - a hands-on leadership role accountable for everything from production deployment and incident response to the regulatory control framework that governs an ATS. You will lead a small, senior team spanning site reliability engineering and database administration, and you will work across environments that are deliberately hybrid: the on-premises environments that carry regulated trading activity, alongside a growing AWS footprint you will help shape and extend. This is a chance to take ownership of a platform that genuinely matters, with real room to modernize how it is run rather than inherit someone else's blueprint. Your responsibilities will be: Lead production release and change management. Own the end-to-end release process for the BIDS trading platform across North American and European production environments - planning, execution, verification and rollback - and chair the weekly change management forum that governs it. Own the operational and regulatory control framework. Maintain the control calendar governing BIDS operations - daily through annual reviews spanning database auditing, privileged access, capacity and market conduct - and ensure each control is performed, evidenced and reviewed on schedule. Lead and develop the production operations team. Manage a team spanning site reliability engineering and database administration and coordinate with the software engineering and infrastructure teams. Set priorities across both specializations and build enough depth that no critical process depends on any one person. You will set the direction for and review the work of the database administration function rather than performing it. Operate and evolve a hybrid production environment. Run the on-premises environments that carry regulated trading activity alongside a growing AWS footprint, applying consistent release, monitoring and control practices across both. Lead the continued migration of workloads to cloud where it reduces risk or cost, without compromising availability of the on-premises platform. Direct the technical response to production incidents. Coordinate diagnosis and recovery during production events, run the alert triage issues across all production environments, and own post-incident review and remediation. Client-impacting and business decisions escalate to the chief operating officer. Own resilience and disaster recovery. Plan and lead quarterly and annual disaster recovery site tests, verify backup and restore procedures, and keep recovery runbooks current and executable. Keep the platform current. Design and schedule upgrade programs across the runtime, database and infrastructure layers, coordinating change windows with infrastructure, network and vendor teams to land them without disrupting trading. The ideal candidate has 10+ years in production operations, technical operations or release engineering, in financial services or another regulated environment. 5+ years leading technical teams. A bachelor's degree in a technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Preferred. Experience at an alternative trading system, exchange or broker-dealer. review_candidates.description: Ever fixed the same problem three times and thought... "There has to be a better way than this." So have we. At First Focus, we don't just want people who can solve technical issues. We want people who are curious enough to wonder why they happened in the first place. If you're the kind of person who notices patterns, enjoys experimenting with new technology, has already spent more time than you'd like to admit talking to ChatGPT or Claude, and thinks "I could automate that" at least once a week, we'd love to meet you. Don't worry, we're not looking for an AI engineer disguised as a Support Technician. We're looking for an exceptional Support Technician who's excited about helping shape the future of IT support. And yes, you'll still have time for merienda. Even if Manila traffic occasionally has other plans. About First Focus First Focus is Australia's best mid-market Managed Service Provider, recognised as the #1 MSP in Australia by Cloudtango for nine consecutive years. With almost 500 people across Australia, New Zealand and the Philippines, we've spent more than 15 years building a company where great people genuinely enjoy coming to work. We believe talented people do their best work when they're trusted, supported and given opportunities to grow. That means less politics, more collaboration, plenty of laughter, and leaders who are happy to roll up their sleeves when needed. One of the values we're especially excited to highlight in this role is Never Stop Growing . Technology moves quickly, and so do we. If you're naturally curious and love learning, you'll fit right in. You can read more about our values here: https://www.firstfocus.com.au/about-us/ Why this role is different This isn't just another Support Technician role. You'll still provide brilliant technical support, delight customers and solve complex issues. But you'll also help us improve how support is delivered. We're looking for someone who doesn't simply close tickets. We want someone who asks: "Why does this keep happening?" You'll identify recurring issues, spot trends across customers, recommend opportunities for automation, and help us use AI to remove repetitive work so our engineers can focus on solving bigger problems. You won't be expected to build every automation yourself. You'll have support from specialists across the business. Your job is recognising the opportunity, asking great questions, and helping us become smarter every week. It's a unique opportunity to influence the future of support at First Focus. Opportunities like this don't come around very often. Requirements What you'll be doing Deliver exceptional technical support across desktops, Microsoft 365, servers, cloud platforms and networking Build trusted relationships with customers by communicating clearly and solving problems with empathy Troubleshoot complex issues while maintaining excellent customer satisfaction Identify recurring incidents and investigate the root cause instead of repeatedly treating the symptoms Recognise opportunities for automation and AI-assisted workflows Work with engineering and automation teams to improve service delivery Share knowledge and contribute to improving documentation and internal processes Mentor teammates where appropriate and actively contribute to a collaborative team environment Continue learning new technologies, especially emerging AI tools and modern support practices What we're looking for You'll probably have: Previous experience working in an MSP or fast-paced IT support environment Strong troubleshooting skills across Microsoft technologies, networking and cloud platforms Excellent communication skills and a genuine desire to help customers Strong knowledge of our tools, customers, recurring issues and the way we work Hands-on experience with, or genuine enthusiasm for, AI tools including ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot or similar platforms Interest in prompt engineering, AI agents, workflow automation or building skills is highly desirable, although not essential A pattern-spotter's mindset. Someone who naturally looks for recurring issues and asks "How do we stop this happening again?" A passion for learning and improving both yourself and the team around you Benefits Why you'll love working here Competitive salary package between ₱75,000 and ₱90,000 per month, plus other benefits Hybrid working arrangements Never Stop Growing, 10 paid study days each year, exam fees paid, salary increases for certifications (conditions apply) HMO from Day 1 with one dependent (spouse) and dental cover Free access to Uprise, including confidential coaching with qualified psychologists and counsellors Day shift, weekends off*, and 25 paid leave days each year Employee referral program worth ₱20,000 MVP Award worth ₱10,000 Loyalty bonuses* Regular social events, End of Financial Year celebrations and Christmas parties Weekly technical training, mentoring and genuine career development Modern offices located at: 29th Floor, Robinsons Cyberscape Gamma, Topaz Road, Ortigas, Pasig City, Metro Manila 26th Floor, Axis Tower One Building, Filinvest Ave, Alabang, Muntinlupa If you're excited by emerging technology, love helping people, enjoy solving problems properly instead of repeatedly, and think AI should make support engineers' lives better instead of replacing them, we'd love to hear from you. Come help us build the next generation of IT support. Neurodiversity: First Focus welcomes applications from Neurodiverse candidates. We recommend & appreciate disclosure along with the application so that a copy of our Neurodiversity Statement can be provided outlining the flexible options we can offer to best showcase your skills. AI in Recruitment: We use AI-assisted recruitment tools to support application review. These tools do not make hiring decisions. All applications are handled by our recruitment team in compliance with the Philippine Data Privacy Act.
